sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of the Carmack Amendment. It asks if the law covers the inland leg of an import shipment. the sides that brought the case say the statute excludes this leg. the opposing sides say the law covers all domestic transport. The dispute centers on statutory interpretation.
